architecture_summary: Next.js 15 App Router codebase with full Domain-Driven Architecture. 9 business domains (author, booking, china, experiences, knowledge, media, services, trade-intel, shared) with clean Repository interfaces, Local-FS repository implementations, and integration gateway stubs (Search/CRM/Payments/Analytics/Calendar/Email/Storage). Dynamic routing covers all 85 static pages across 7 route-group contexts. Homepage refactored to src/features/home/ feature module.
design_system_summary: Tailwind CSS v4 variables mapping Beiruti (AR) and Bricolage/Inter/JetBrains (EN) typography, an 8px spacing system, premium graphite/gold/blue colors, and spring-based Framer Motion configurations.
